title: IPCC AR6: 2019 CO2 was higher than at any time in at least 2 million years
summary: Statement A.2.1 says 2019 CO2 was higher than at any time in at least 2 million years, and that methane and nitrous oxide were higher than at any time in at least 800,000 years.
body: IPCC Working Group I statement A.2.1 says that in 2019, atmospheric CO2 concentrations were higher than at any time in at least 2 million years, at high confidence, and that concentrations of methane and nitrous oxide were higher than at any time in at least 800,000 years, at very high confidence. NOAA's ice-core page, separately, says an 800,000-year series never exceeded 300 ppm. This card is the assessment sentence, including its confidence labels.
